question.prompt: 8 data values are randomly selected as a sample. The mean of 5 of the values is 10, and the mean of the other 3 values is 18. What is the sample mean?

solutions.explanation: The total is \(5\times10+3\times18=104\), and the sample mean is \(104\div8=13\).
solutions.title: Combine the group totals
